name: When should I consider upgrading my bathroom's electrical panel?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading my bathroom's electrical panel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading your bathroom's electrical panel if you're planning extensive electrical additions that exceed your current panel's capacity, such as installing a large jetted tub, multiple high-wattage heat lamps, or a sauna. Other signs include frequently tripping breakers, dimming lights when appliances turn on, or an outdated fuse box. An upgrade ensures your system can safely handle increased electrical demand.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade your electrical panel if extensive bathroom additions exceed current capacity, or if you experience frequent tripped breakers or dimming lights.
